The '''1968–69 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]] by five points over nearest rival [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]]. [[Falkirk F.C.|Falkirk]] and [[Arbroath F.C.|Arbroath]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1969–70 Scottish Division Two|1969-70 Second Division]].
